title: Lasting Legacy Pack Manifest
description: Manifest for a modpack or datapack. A manifest is either single version (has 'mc_version') or multi variant (has 'variants'), never both.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Stable pack identifier. Matches the pack's folder name.

loader.description: Mod loader (e.g. fabric, forge, neoforge, quilt).

version.description: Pack version (ideally CalVer). Required for  single-version manifests and generated for experimental.

mc_version.description: Minecraft version. single version manifests. this is mutually exclusive with 'variants'.

variants.description: MULTI-VARIANT packs: independently-built variants published as separate versions under one project. Publish order = array order (last lands on top).

base.description: If true, this pack is a base others may link to. Bases cannot declare 'performance_base' (no chains).

performance_base.description: Declares that this pack consumes its performance baseline (mods + config) from another pack. Sync copies the base's named source subdir into this pack's named target subdir for each mapping. CROSS-PLATFORM MAPPINGS ARE FORBIDDEN: source and target must share the same platform suffix (-mr or -cf), because copying Modrinth-sourced mods into a CurseForge pack (or vice versa) risks license violations. If the base lacks a named source subdir, that mapping fails validation. Each mapping is explicit — there is no inference.

pack.description: ID of the base pack. Must exist and have 'base': true.

mappings.description: Explicit source target subdir pairings. One per target subdir that should receive the baseline.

source.description: Subdir in the base pack to copy from (e.g. '26.1.2-mr'). Must end in '-mr' or '-cf'.

target.description: Subdir in THIS pack to copy into (e.g. '26.1.2-mr', 'tu0-mr'). Must share the same platform suffix as 'source'.

shared_assets.description: ID of a pack providing shared assets (e.g. 'lce-common'). Must exist. Independent of 'performance_base'.

allOf.description: No chains: a base cannot consume from another base.
